findings.claim: The diff adds a new helper, `_drive_thumbnail_neighbours`, with the constants `_CLIP_DRIVE_FETCH_MAX`/`_CLIP_DRIVE_FETCH_FACTORS` and a new `drive` parameter on `_vector_search_clip`. The helper runs up to four widening KNNs (k up to 4096) and reads `embeddings`/`indexed_files` inside the CLIP channel. The touch points describe only "the KNN query and the branch on include_scene_clip".
findings.impact: With a drive, the CLIP channel no longer runs a single KNN of k=rrf_candidates. It can run up to four KNNs plus an `IN` lookup of up to 4,096 ids in search.db, and the drive and active filter now runs before the gates rather than only in `_build_results`. Spec §6 still says "The drive filter after the KNN stays where it is: `_build_results`", which could lead a reader to strip the new filter from the channel as if it were redundant.
